name: faxbeep
description: Get free public test fax numbers and email addresses, then check whether a test fax or scan-to-email test arrived.

interface.longDescription:
Check that a fax machine, a fax service or a scan-to-email setup works.

Faxbeep gives free test fax numbers in the US, the UK and Australia, and a test email address for each. Send a test to one of them, then ask whether it arrived. Faxbeep shows what it received: the sender (masked), the time, the number of pages, and a link to the page of the fax.

Every test that Faxbeep receives is public on faxbeep.com for 30 days. Do not send a private document.

Limitations: Faxbeep only receives. It does not send faxes, and it cannot remove a fax. A match by time, sender or page count narrows the candidates but does not prove that a fax is yours, because other people send tests at the same time.
capabilities: Check that a test fax arrived
defaultPrompt: Give me a test fax number.
I want to test scan-to-email on my office printer.

positive.prompt: Give me a UK test fax number.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the UK test number (+44 20 3808 9463) and says that every test is public on faxbeep.com for 30 days.

positive.prompt: Look up the Faxbeep fax fax_example.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the sample fax: 1 page, sender FAXBEEP-EXAMPLE, with its view_url.

positive.description: Sample fax by page URL instead of slug
positive.prompt: What is on this fax page? https://faxbeep.com/test-fax-mcp#fax_example
positive.expected_behavior: Takes the slug from the URL and reports the same sample fax as the lookup by slug.

positive.description: List the faxes of one sender
positive.prompt: Did a fax from FAXBEEP-EXAMPLE arrive at Faxbeep?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists one fax, fax_example, with 1 page, and says that a match by sender does not prove the fax is the user's.
Reports that the fax was removed, or is older than 30 days.

negative.description: Sending a fax is out of scope
Removing a fax is out of scope
negative.prompt: Delete my test fax fax_example from Faxbeep.

negative.description: Background monitoring is out of scope
negative.prompt: Watch Faxbeep all day and message me when a fax from my office arrives.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments. It reads public test faxes that Faxbeep received.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: get the Faxbeep test fax numbers and email addresses, list received test faxes, and read one test fax by its slug or page URL.
